**B08 — Admission request**  
Leave the child’s name blank for your sister.  
NEEDS-YOU — name of the preschool or daycare.

**B09 — Applicant name and B30 — Second emergency contact name**  
Copy these three values into each name field, on one line in the order shown. Put one space between each part.

GIVEN_P1  
MIDDLE_P1  
SURNAME_P1

**B10 — Applicant telephone and B30 — Second emergency contact telephone**  
Copy this value into the matching slot in both fields: C for cell, W for work, or H for home.

PHONE_P1

**B11 — Applicant email**  
NEEDS-YOU — your email address.

**B12 — Relationship to child**  
Aunt

Leave **B01–B07** blank for preschool staff and **B13–B29** blank for your sister.
